tables.heading_context: ## The Founders: Modern Dance First Generation
rows: Dancer inside a tube of fabric; form IS the grief
Compare Duncan's natural movement, bare feet, torso center, anti-ballet stance, and classical references.
"Natural" was an aesthetic construction, not absence of technique.
Look at contraction/release, pelvis/spine, mythic structure, breath, gendered interiority, and codified training.
Graham rejected ballet's verticality while building an equally rigorous system.
Diagnose fall/recovery, weight, breath, humanist themes, and gravity as compositional force.
Limon extends Humphrey and Graham rather than fitting one pure lineage.
Track chance operations, independence of music/dance/design, spatial decentralization, and phrase generation.
Chance procedures are structured systems, not randomness without craft.
Use task movement, pedestrian action, anti-spectacle, site, repetition, and ordinary bodies.
Rejecting theatrical convention did not mean rejecting form.
Examine shared weight, rolling point of contact, consent, momentum, and nonhierarchical partnering.
Apparent spontaneity requires trained listening and safety discipline.
Compare Forsythe's off-axis ballet logic with Bausch's repetition, text, design, and biography.
Both disrupt ballet/theater from inside high technique, not from technical absence.
